action.objective: Develop the g1 knight to f3, controlling d4/e5 and preparing kingside castling.
action.rationale: g1f3 is verified at depth 4 with exact score 3, safety complete (no mate-in-one, no tactical refutation found). It develops a minor and improves king safety/central control. Black's d5 push can be met with d2d3 or c3b5 ideas. No alternative verified move exists, so I commit the sole commit-ready move.
